name: @sim/packet-tracer-format
description: Browser-safe decoder for Cisco Packet Tracer .pkt/.pka containers. Reverses the container's obfuscation, block cipher and compression to recover the XML topology document, under central untrusted-input bounds. It never executes file content, never fetches a remote resource and never maps into a SimulatorNet LabDocument — that is the importer's job.
